description: v4 only. Per-asset limits for one (hub, spoke) pair: supply and borrow caps, whether the asset is active there, whether it is halted, and the risk premium threshold. Read it before sizing a large position, because a cap is what turns a valid-looking supply into a reverting one. 'halted' stops supply, borrow, withdraw and repay alike; an asset that is simply not active was never configured on that spoke, which is a different thing from one that was turned off. Both ids come from get_reserve_details for any reserve, which is the route that works before a wallet holds anything on that spoke.

spokeId.description: spokeId from get_reserve_details, or from get_user_positions (not the spoke address).

version.description: Optional, and only 'v4': this tool exists on v4 only.
